Wrap the surface in an outer shell with 1px padding and a 34px radius. Drive the shell with linear-gradient(rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.2), rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.035) 50%, rgba(245, 168, 75, 0.14)) so the edge reads like premium depth instead of a flat stroke. Keep the actual stroke understated so the gradient shell remains the hero edge treatment. Inset the real content surface inside the wrapper with a slightly smaller radius so the gradient only appears as a hairline frame. 表面样例 Glass 边框、阴影与模糊处理按生成的层次体系预览。 Surface Glass Border 1px #F2EEE5 Shadow rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18) 0px 18px 48px 0px Blur 20px 形状 Shapes rely on a tight radius system anchored by 13px and scaled across cards, buttons, and supporting surfaces. Icon geometry should stay compatible with that soft-to-controlled silhouette. 圆角族 13px14px18px24px 图标集 Solar 主圆角 13px 图标风格 线性 图标集 Solar 规范与禁忌 遵循这些约束，可让后续生成保持与当前体系一致，避免漂移到相邻风格。 建议 • 以主色盘作为强调与操作状态的主要点缀色。 • keep spacing aligned to the detected 5.22px rhythm. • 在卡片与控件上统一复用玻璃表面处理。 • keep corner radii within the detected 13px, 14px, 18px, 24px, 999px family. 避免 • 除非页面需要新的语义状态，否则不要引入核心色盘角色之外的额外点缀色。 • 不要混用无关的阴影或模糊配方，以免破坏当前深度体系。 • 不要exceed the detected moderate motion intensity without a deliberate reason. 动效 动效克制且以界面为主导，贯穿文字、布局与区块过渡。 时序主要聚集在 250ms 与 280ms。 缓动偏好 Cubic 0, 0, 0.2, 1 与 Cubic 0.4, 0, 0.2, 1。 滚动编排采用 GSAP ScrollTrigger 控制区块显现与节奏。 动效强度 适中 时长 250ms280ms900ms1600ms 缓动 Cubic 0, 0, 0.2, 1Cubic 0.4, 0, 0.2, 1Ease OutEase 滚动模式 GSAP ScrollTrigger 60 FPS 示例过渡 · 250ms WebGL 三维引擎 + WebGL Reconstruct the graphics as a full-bleed background field using webgl, renderer, antialias, DPR 限制, custom shaders. The effect should read as retro-futurist, technical, and meditative: perspective grid field with green on black and sparse spacing. Build it from grid lines + depth fade so the effect reads clearly. Animate it as slow breathing pulse. Interaction can react to the pointer, but only as a subtle drift. Preserve reduced motion + dom fallback. 技术栈 三维引擎WebGL 场景 全出血背景场 效果 Perspective grid field 图元 Grid lines + depth fade 动效 缓慢呼吸脉冲 交互 指针响应式漂移 渲染 WebGL, Renderer, antialias, DPR 限制, custom shaders 技法 Perspective grid呼吸脉冲指针视差着色器渐变噪点场 代码参考 HTML 参考 html
